name: Treacherous Quagmire
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-08: Revolution on the Riverside
description: A patch of treacherous bog attempts to submerge creatures that step onto it.
disable: DC 18 Survival (trained) to disturb the surface and make the quagmire plainly visible.
reset: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 24 hours
routine:
(1 action) On its initiative, the quagmire pulls each creature within it 1 square toward the center of the quagmire and 1 step further submerged; a creature that is submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that is submerged up to its neck is pulled under and has to hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature in the quagmire can attempt a DC 20 Athletics check to Swim to either raise itself by 1 step if its submerged to its neck or worse, or to swim out of the quagmire if its submerged up to only its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down 1 step. A creature that Swims out of the quagmire escapes the hazard and is Prone adjacent to the quagmire. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar tool, or attempt to pull a creature within their reach out with a DC 20 Athletics check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check.

generalAbilities.name: Submerge
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature walks into a quagmire.

Effect The triggering creature sinks into the quagmire up to its waist in its current square. The quagmire rolls initiative if it hasn't already.
